description: Convert messy mixed-format citations to proper APA 7th edition format. Open /home/ga/Documents/raw_citations.docx which contains 10 real academic citations in various incorrect formats (some MLA, some Chicago, some incomplete). For each citation: (1) Reformat author names to APA style (LastName, F. M.), (2) Place year in parentheses after authors, (3) Convert article titles to sentence case, (4) Italicize journal and book titles (not article titles), (5) Apply 0.5-inch hanging indent to all entries, (6) Sort entries alphabetically by first author's last name, (7) Add a centered 'References' heading at the top of the list. Save the document (Ctrl+S).
